fusions.name: Sticky Threads
fusions.desc: Spins sticky threads that deal 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, leave each [Slowed] for 5 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Silk Line
fusions.desc: Shoots a silk line at the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Anchored Lines
fusions.desc: Reduces damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Patient Strike
fusions.desc: When you go a while without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 25% for 8 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
